200.answer: To use Call Forwarding on Bell Mobility, go to the Call Settings menu from your phone's main menu, then select Call Forwarding. You can choose the type of call to forward, such as all voice calls or only unanswered calls. Follow the prompts to activate it, including entering the forwarding destination number.

snippets.text: Select the type of call you'd like to forward. For example, you can forward all voice calls or only calls that you don't answer. Follow the prompts to activate including entering the forwarding destination number. Remember that if this is a long distance call, you'll be billed the long distance fees. Once Call Forwarding is activated, you'll receive a free text message on your phone to confirm that the activation is complete. Turning off Call Forwarding How to turn off Call Forwarding from Bell Mobility Follow these steps to disable Call Forwarding on the Bell Mobility network. Go to the Call Settings menu from the main menu of your phone. Select Call Forwarding. Select the Call Forwarding type you'd like to deactivate. Follow the prompts to deactivate. If you have activated Call Forwarding and want to restore your voicemail, select Deactivate All from the deactivation menu.
